noeuds.role: Plays on the object a movement made in Assets → Movement (steps: position, rotation, size, transparency). The engine computes everything in between. While it moves, the object's gravity and controls are switched off. The next nodes run without waiting.
noeuds.exemple: a platform that goes up and down in a loop, or a sliding door.

noeuds.role: Stops the movement running on the object. It stays where it is.
noeuds.exemple: stop the platform when the player presses a button.

noeuds.schema: Inputs: Object, Path name, Speed (pixels per second), Turn to face the way it goes (yes / no), Random side offset (pixels, ±: each one walks in its own lane), Avoid the others: step aside to avoid overlapping and overtake slower ones (yes / no), Usable width to step aside (pixels on each side of the road centre), Image angle (0 = faces right, 90 = faces down)  →  Outputs: Right away / Arrived
noeuds.role: Makes the object follow a path drawn with the “Path” tool in Assets: it is placed on the starting point, then moves from point to point at the chosen speed. At a crossroads it picks its exit as you set it (random, take turns, by a variable). The “Reached the end” exit fires when it reaches a point with no exit. With “Random side offset”, each object walks in its own lane (random shift): several enemies advance side by side instead of overlapping. With “Avoid the others”, an object that catches up with a slower one steps aside, overtakes it and returns to its lane; if the road is too narrow, it follows instead.
noeuds.exemple: An enemy appears: Follow the path “Enemy_path”, speed 150. “Reached the end” exit → Deal damage to the base, then Destroy the object.

noeuds.role: Stops the object where it is: it no longer follows its path (the “Reached the end” exit will not fire).
noeuds.exemple: An enemy is frozen by a trap: Stop the path, then later Follow the path again so it moves on.

noeuds.role: Stops the object dead: no more speed, push, jump or automatic movement.
noeuds.exemple: freeze an enemy hit by an ice spell.

noeuds.role: Turns off the object's automatic movements: move continuously, pursue and flee.
noeuds.exemple: the enemy stops chasing when the player hides.

noeuds.role: The object moves by itself, in the direction it is facing, at the chosen speed.
noeuds.exemple: a bullet or a moving car.

noeuds.schema: Inputs: Object A, Object B, Speed, Diagonals (yes / no), Stop, These tags block the path (other units, separated by commas)  →  Outputs: Right away / Arrived
noeuds.role: Object A goes to object B, finding the shortest path by itself, square by square, without going through walls ("Solid" tiles of a tile layer, fixed physical objects). The path is updated when B moves. “Arrived” runs when A touches B. The "Stop" setting lets the object stop on a neighbouring cell, well centered (grid games); "These tags block the path" makes it go around other units.
noeuds.exemple: a ghost chasing the player through a maze.

noeuds.schema: Inputs: Object, X position, Y position, Speed, Diagonals (yes / no), These tags block the path (other units, separated by commas)  →  Outputs: Right away / Arrived
noeuds.role: Object A goes to point X, Y around the walls, by the shortest path (square by square). With =doigt.x and =doigt.y, it goes where the screen is touched. “Arrived” runs on arrival. If there is no path, it stays where it is.
noeuds.exemple: tap a square to send the hero there, in a strategy game or a dungeon.

noeuds.role: The object stops following its path (“Go to an object (path)” or “Go to a point (path)”) and stays where it is.
noeuds.exemple: the fly stops when the game is won.

noeuds.schema: Inputs: Object, Column (0 = the first), Row (0 = the first)
noeuds.role: Puts object A exactly in the middle of the chosen cell (column and row, counted from 0 at the top left). The grid is the one of the scene's tile map. With the 🔗 button, plug in “Touched column” and “Touched row” to send it to the cell the finger touches.
noeuds.exemple: move a piece to the touched cell in a board game.

noeuds.role: Object A stays in its cell but goes back exactly to the middle. Handy when a move stopped between two cells.
noeuds.exemple: re-center a hero after its move.

noeuds.schema: Inputs: Object, Column, Row, Speed, Diagonals (yes / no), These tags block the path (other units, separated by commas)  →  Outputs: Right away / Arrived
noeuds.role: The object walks to the CENTER of the cell (column, row), going around walls, blocking terrains and the units with the given tags. Default: the cell touched by the finger. "Arrived" output once on the cell.
noeuds.exemple: send a hero to a touched blue cell.

noeuds.schema: Inputs: Object, Direction, Speed, These tags block the path (other units, separated by commas)  →  Outputs: Arrived / Blocked (wall, terrain, unit, edge)
noeuds.role: Moves the piece one cell (up, down, left, right), well centered. If the cell is a wall, a blocking terrain, a unit (tags) or the edge of the map: "Blocked" output. Otherwise "Arrived" at the end of the step.
noeuds.exemple: move a board-game piece with ◀ ▶ ▲ ▼ buttons.

noeuds.role: Object A moves by itself towards object B, at the chosen speed.
noeuds.exemple: a ghost following the player.

noeuds.role: Object A moves by itself away from object B, at the chosen speed.
noeuds.exemple: a chicken running away from the player.

noeuds.role: Pushes the object in a direction (in degrees: 0 = right, 90 = down, 180 = left, 270 = up) with the chosen force.
noeuds.exemple: a spring that sends the player diagonally.

noeuds.role: Launches the object upwards (negative number) or downwards (positive), and gives it physics so it falls back.
noeuds.exemple: a jump: force -15.

noeuds.schema: Inputs: Object, How it moves, Speed, Jump height, Is a ladder, Collectable
noeuds.role: Changes what the object does during the game, with the same choices as the Inspector's "Object behavior" window: Scenery, Ground / wall, Falls and bounces, Platform character, Patrol (back and forth), Top-down character, Dragged with a finger. You can also change the speed, the jump height, "is a ladder" and "collectable". Every setting left on "(don't change)" keeps its value.
noeuds.exemple: a crate standing still (Ground / wall) starts to fall when a lever is pulled: Change the behavior → Falls and bounces.

noeuds.schema: Inputs: Object, Strength (0 = stop), Duration (milliseconds, 1000 = 1 s), Keep going while moving (yes / no)
noeuds.role: Makes the object hop (a small visual bounce) with the chosen intensity and duration. 0 stops it. It can keep going while the object moves.
noeuds.exemple: a character that hops as it walks.

noeuds.schema: Inputs: Object A, Object B, Angle offset (degrees)
noeuds.role: Turns object A towards object B. The offset fixes the image's direction (0 = the image faces right).
noeuds.exemple: a turret aiming at the player.

noeuds.schema: Inputs: Object, X position, Y position, Duration (seconds)
noeuds.role: Smoothly moves the object to position X, Y over the chosen time (seconds). The next nodes run without waiting.
noeuds.exemple: a moving platform or a menu sliding onto the screen.
